market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $120 by mid-2026 would require an unprecedented >4x rally from current ~$30 levels. This price is far above any historical peak, including the inflation-adjusted highs of 1980 and 2011. Given no fundamental catalyst for such a parabolic move, the true probability is near zero, while the market implies a 6.7% chance.
evidence_points: Silver all-time high (nominal) ~$50 in 1980 and 2011; inflation-adjusted high ~$130-$140, but that peak was a brief spike not sustained in futures settlement prices
Current CME silver futures (front month) settle around $28–$32, requiring a ~300% increase in ~15 months
No credible supply/demand or monetary scenario suggests silver will quadruple in such a short window
CME settlement prices for active month futures have never approached $120 in the entire history of the contract
sources_consulted: CME Group historical silver settlement prices
